title.en: The spectrum of a square wave

concept.hr: Pravokutni signal: zbroj neparnih harmonika; uz skok ostaje prebačaj od oko 9 %
concept.en: A square wave is a sum of odd harmonics; at each jump a 9 % overshoot stays

summary.hr: Fourierov red pravokutnog signala do N-tog harmonika (1 do 499): neparni harmonici amplitude 4/(kπ), njihov zbroj i Gibbsov fenomen na skokovima.
summary.en: The Fourier series of a square wave up to the N-th harmonic (1 to 499): odd harmonics of amplitude 4/(kπ), their sum and the Gibbs phenomenon at the jumps.

what.hr: Aplet applet_rectangle.html i tekst odjeljka o nesinusnim signalima (50ohm.de, hrvatski prijevod)
what.en: The applet applet_rectangle.html and the text of the non-sinusoidal signals section (50ohm.de, Croatian translation)

changes.hr: Prilagođen simdeck kitu i nacrtan bez vanjskih biblioteka (SVG umjesto Chart.js i jQueryja), preveden na engleski, dodani spektar harmonika, predlošci i prebačaj na skoku s brojem
changes.en: Adapted to the simdeck kit and drawn without outside libraries (SVG instead of Chart.js and jQuery), translated into English, the harmonic spectrum, presets and the overshoot at the jump with its number added
